name: HashiCorp Vault Secret Lookup
description: A HashiCorp Vault key/value store another credential reads an input from. This type is never injected into a job: it is read FROM, at dispatch, to fill an input of the credential bound to it.

fields.label: Server URL
fields.help_text: The base URL of the Vault server, for example https://vault.example.com:8200. The certificate chain is always verified; there is no option to skip it.

fields.label: Token
fields.help_text: A Vault token with read access to the paths this credential will be pointed at.

fields.label: CA Certificate
fields.help_text: A PEM certificate authority bundle to verify the server against, for a Vault with a private chain. Left empty, the host's own trust store is used.

fields.label: Namespace
fields.help_text: The Vault Enterprise namespace to read within. Leave empty on open source Vault, which has none.

fields.label: API Version
fields.help_text: The key/value secrets engine version this mount runs. v2 is the default for a modern Vault and reads through a different path than v1.
